summary: Redirect to the requested track audio file
description: Returns an HTTP 302 redirect to the audio file for a given track ID. If the track's audiodownload_allowed (or track_audiodownload_allowed) flag is false, a 404 error is returned. Malformed requests yield a 500 error. This endpoint does not inherit the common parameter declarations of other methods.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the track to download/stream. Exactly one ID is accepted.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows without pagination. Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Desired audio format for the returned file. Defaults to mp31 (96 kbps) if omitted.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Indicates whether the request is for downloading or streaming, helping the server optimise handling.

notes: If 'audiodownload_allowed'/'track_audiodownload_allowed' is false for the requested track, the endpoint returns HTTP 404.
The endpoint performs an HTTP redirect; the final audio URL is provided in the 'Location' header.
Only a single track ID is allowed; providing multiple IDs results in an error.
